un-ga-res-51-198-b: General Assembly Resolution 51/198 B, adopted in 1998 — the lettered suffix marking part B of a compound decision. The modern Assembly's multi-part texts. The designation and year are preserved; the subject is in the text.
un-ga-res-49-236-b: Resolution 49/236 B, adopted in 1994 — part B of the compound text. The decision's second half. The designation and year are certain; the subject belongs to the text.
types-of-children-s-literature-a-collect: Educator Walter Barnes assembled this landmark anthology showing the many kinds of writing for children — fairy tales, fables, myths, poetry, and realistic stories. Each section is chosen to show teachers and parents what children's literature could be at its best. Long used in classrooms, it helped establish the serious study of books for young readers.
